name: FL-17
label: Safe R

key_factors: District's R+10 partisan lean favors Steube
Steube holds a large fundraising and cash-on-hand edge
Prediction markets price Steube at ~94% to win
No polls or expert ratings available
model.rationale: The R+10 district, incumbent Steube's dominant fundraising advantage, and markets pricing him near 94% all point to a comfortable Republican win with little evidence of Democratic strength.
model.watch: A major late outside-spending intervention or unexpected scandal could narrow the margin, though nothing currently signals that.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Greg Steube, the Republican incumbent, is seeking reelection in a southwest Florida district with a strong Republican lean of about ten points. He has raised roughly $1.3 million and holds over $2 million in cash, while Democratic challenger Matthew Montavon has raised under $100,000 with minimal cash on hand. No independent or outside spending has appeared in the race.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this contest, so the outlook rests on fundamentals and prediction markets, which price Steube's chances at about 94 percent. The combination of district lean, incumbency, and financial dominance makes this a safe Republican seat, with the main uncertainty being the exact size of the margin rather than the winner.
